summary: Turbo Energy, S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of its 2026 Extraordinary General Meeting of shareholders held on April 27, 2026. Shareholders voted on six proposals including renewal of delegations to increase share capital and issue convertible or exchangeable securities, among others. All proposals passed with overwhelming support (over 42 million votes in favor out of 42.2 million voted). This is a routine shareholder meeting report with no special situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or activist campaign. The filing confirms ordinary course corporate governance actions.
